headline: Sensex and Nifty end lower, snapping winning streak as inflation concerns and rising crude oil prices weigh on sentiment

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Inflation concerns weighed heavily on market sentiment and investor confidence
Rising crude oil prices revived fears of persistent inflationary pressure
Weak global cues and volatility in AI-related trades impacted domestic markets
Profit booking occurred after the indices' recent winning streak
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 319 points to close at 25,144 while Nifty 50 slipped below 25,150
Passenger vehicle wholesales grew 12% YoY in October, exceeding 5 lakh units
Eicher Motors and ABB India reported strong quarterly financial results with double-digit profit growth
The CAG has initiated its first in-depth performance audit of fertiliser subsidies since 2011
summary: Indian markets snapped their winning streak on November 13, with the Sensex falling 319 points due to inflation and crude oil concerns. Despite the broad sell-off, Eicher Motors and ABB India posted strong earnings, while Shriram Finance emerged as a top loser. Additionally, the auto sector reported robust October wholesales, crossing the 5-lakh unit milestone.
